contexts.text: All that region is called the tract of the Church where are those who are instructed in the doctrine of true faith... as Europe, where the Christian Church now is.
(Not merely those born in Europe are saved.)
Some European Spirits then injected direful scandals...
Even in so learned a part of the world as Europe... where the Word is... there is no Knowledge whatever of the internal sense.
By the holy Jerusalem descending from Heaven is meant a new Church with the gentiles after the present one which is in our European part of the world has been vastated.
That what is left of the worship of that nation will have its end together with the end of the present Church in Europe. Signified.

Communication with the universal Heaven exists by means of the Word; for which reason, by the Divine Providence of the Lord, the kingdoms of Europe, and especially those in which the Word is read, have a universal intercourse with the nations outside the Church.
Because the Christian religion is confined to the lesser part of the habitable globe, which is called Europe.
The reason this Revelation was made to John in Patmos, was that it was an island... between Asia and Europe... and Europe signifies those to whom the Church is about to come.
I was told that those horsemen had gone to the wise in the kingdoms of Europe...

The Angels once assembled from Europe some hundreds of those who were distinguished for their cleverness, learning and wisdom; and questioned them concerning the difference between marriage and adultery... All but ten replied that the public law makes the difference...
The learned European Spirits objected... Such are Europeans, who are called Christians...
On the infidelity of European Spirits.
They cared almost nothing for what the evil European Spirits injected...
Such (adulterous Sirens) are from Europe, where there is Christianity; not from the Asiatic, African, and American regions.
Such (Sirens) are at this day vastly numerous, from Europe.
Wolff wanted to be saluted as the light of Europe.
On the atheistical crew within Europe where the Church is.
This (idea of God as a Man) is inscribed from Heaven on the nature of the nations outside of Europe, and also on some within Europe.
The Church which is now perishing in Europe will be established in Africa... but not by emissaries from Christians.
All Christians, that is, all in Europe know from the Word that He was conceived from Jehovah...

Europeans... think exteriorly, and only receive truths in the memory, nor do they see that they are truths from any other source than because they have been so instructed from infancy, and because some one has said so whom they believe to know, thus from authority... Europeans are they who in our earth are of the genius in which are the Angels in the Spiritual Kingdom. LJPost 118.
The English are of a different genius from the other nations of Europe.
(The Africans said) that those from Europe are not admitted to them...
A tract which is known to Europeans...
When Europe is mentioned, the Angels perceive the north.
The idea of Europeans (about the Lord's Humanity), especially that of the learned, is fallacious...
